summary: xAI announced that Grok Build, its in-chat app-building feature, is now available to all plan tiers on web and mobile, adding publishing, remix, custom domains, GitHub export, secrets storage, connectors, and in-app access to Grok's models.

mechanisms.reason: Expanding a chat-embedded app builder with built-in model access from a limited beta to every plan and wiring it into X broadens the surfaces that can generate Grok API calls.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Build is now available on every plan, on the web and on mobile.

practices.reason: Apps built with Grok Build can call Grok's chat, image and voice APIs without developers provisioning or rotating API keys, removing a standard integration step.
practices.quote: Turn on the SpaceXAI APIs for an app and it can call Grok for chat, images, and voice from inside its own code — no keys to create, paste, or rotate.

practices.reason: Export to GitHub lets a team move a generated app into a normal repo and editor workflow, changing how a prototype would be handed off for further engineering.
practices.quote: Export to GitHub. Push the whole project to a repo and keep going in an editor, or in Grok Build for the terminal .
